rows.description: An instrument that returns wrong values on known-answer cases.
mapping: LinearInstrument(slope, intercept) -> one-step #257 model writing slope*x+intercept into y
each Perplexity known-answer case -> a #257 builder draw (cycled; the gate always takes 12)
the gate then plants leak/coef defects on top -- planted on the instrument, not on the case

[CHOICE] a static instrument has no start state in #257's dynamic-model gate, so the adapter supplies one; y0 in {0, 1, -1} is run and y0=0 is primary. The gate's 'coef' plant scales the transfer by 1.1, so it moves nothing on any case whose required flux (answer - y0) is zero: y0=0 blinds it on the x=0 case, y0=1 on the x=1 case, y0=-1 on none. The gate verdict on a clean instrument is therefore a property of this adapter choice -- coded ADAPTER, not read as a result
